description: This PHP class `PendingTimesheetSummary` belongs to the `OrangeHRM` Human Resource Management system. It is part of the dashboard's action summary components, specifically handling the aggregation of pending timesheets that require approvers' attention. The class constructs search parameters for employee timesheets based on accessible employee IDs and user roles, and provides methods to retrieve the count of pending timesheets and related metadata.

classes.name: PendingTimesheetSummary
classes.description: Handles the summation of pending timesheets requiring approval, based on user roles and employee IDs, within the OrangeHRM dashboard module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes search parameters for employee timesheets based on provided employee IDs and accessible action states (approve/reject).

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns a fixed identifier (2) representing the group category for this summary type.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns a string label identifying the group as 'Timesheets To Approve'.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Retrieves the total count of employee timesheets pending action (approve/reject) based on constructed search parameters.
